releases.body:
## What's Changed

### Removed: oc-mnemoria-judge sub-agent

The `oc-mnemoria-judge` sub-agent has been removed entirely.

### Requires mnemoria CLI >= 0.3.4

- The install script now checks the installed mnemoria version using semver comparison and auto-upgrades if below 0.3.4
- Fresh installs run `cargo install mnemoria` (latest) which satisfies the minimum
- All version references updated across source, tests, and documentation

### Files changed

- **Deleted**: `agents/oc-mnemoria-judge.md`
- **Updated**: `install.sh` — removed agent installation step, added `version_gte()` semver check
- **Updated**: `README.md` — removed entire "oc-mnemoria-judge Subagent" section (~55 lines)
- **Updated**: `src/plugin.ts`, `src/core/mnemoria-cli.ts`, `src/core/mnemoria-cli.test.ts` — version references
- **Updated**: `package.json`, `package-lock.json` — version bump to 0.3.4

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/one-bit/oc-mnemoria/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4

## What's Changed

- **Slash commands renamed** from `/memory *` to `/mn-*` (e.g. `/mn-ask`, `/mn-search`, `/mn-stats`)
- **Agent renamed** from `memory-judge` to `oc-mnemoria-judge`
- **No default model** on the judge agent — users should set a low-cost model via `opencode.json` override
- **Simplified installation** — README now documents only the `curl | sh` method
- **Install script** installs commands to project-local `.opencode/commands/` instead of global config

Aligned with [mnemoria v0.3.3](https://github.com/one-bit/mnemoria/releases/tag/v0.3.3).

releases.name: v0.1.1 — Plugin Loader Fix
releases.body:
## Bug Fix

- **fix: use `oc-mnemoria/plugin` subpath to avoid OpenCode plugin loader crash** — OpenCode's plugin loader iterates over all module exports and calls each as a plugin function. The bare `oc-mnemoria` import resolves to the main entry which re-exports non-function values (e.g. `DEFAULT_CONFIG`), causing `TypeError: fn is not a function`. Using the `/plugin` subpath exports only the plugin function and avoids this issue. ([#13543](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/13543))

## Other Changes

- chore: update `.gitignore` and remove `opencode.json`
- docs: add GitHub Sponsors funding config
- docs: add npm version badge to README

## Install / Upgrade

```sh
cargo install mnemoria
```

Update your `opencode.json` to use the `/plugin` subpath:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["oc-mnemoria/plugin"]
}
```

## Links

- **npm**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/oc-mnemoria
- **mnemoria crate**: https://crates.io/crates/mnemoria
- **OpenCode**: https://opencode.ai

releases.name: v0.1.0 — Initial Public Release
releases.body:
Persistent shared memory (hive mind) for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) agents, powered by the [mnemoria](https://crates.io/crates/mnemoria) Rust engine.

## Highlights

- **Shared hive mind** — all agents (plan, build, ask, review) read/write to a single persistent memory store
- **Agent tagging** — every entry is tagged with the agent that created it via mnemoria's native `--agent` flag
- **Hybrid search** — BM25 + semantic search (model2vec embeddings) via mnemoria v0.3.1
- **Append-only storage** — CRC32 checksum chains with corruption recovery
- **Auto-capture** — tool usage (read, bash, edit, write, grep, glob) is automatically recorded with intent linking
- **System prompt injection** — recent cross-agent context injected at session start

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `remember` | Store a categorized observation in shared memory |
| `search_memory` | Keyword + semantic hybrid search |
| `ask_memory` | Natural language questions against the store |
| `memory_stats` | View store statistics |
| `timeline` | Browse memories chronologically |

## Install

\`\`\`sh
cargo install mnemoria
\`\`\`

Add to your \`opencode.json\`:

\`\`\`json
{
  "\$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["oc-mnemoria"]
}
\`\`\`

## Links

- **npm**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/oc-mnemoria
- **mnemoria crate**: https://crates.io/crates/mnemoria
- **OpenCode**: https://opencode.ai
